run_launch_fastapi: run the online serving layer with FastAPI for GPU-less rendering preprocessing and postprocessing
create_render_subcommand: create a GPU-less rendering subcommand that launches a FastAPI server for preprocessing and postprocessing only
build_launch_subcommand: build a nested CLI subcommand that dispatches to component-specific vLLM launch commands like render
test_validate_serve_args: test the validation of parsed vLLM serve arguments for correctness before launching a component
summarize_cmd_init: summarize the cmd_init function that returns the list of CLI subcommand classes for the vllm launch command
